# Smart Feni (স্মার্ট ফেনী)

> স্মার্ট ফেনী (Smart Feni) is a hyperlocal community service directory and platform for Feni district, Bangladesh, covering Feni Sadar and the five upazilas of Chhagalnaiya, Daganbhuiyan, Parshuram, Fulgazi, and Sonagazi. Tagline: "Global Standards. Local Service." The platform is a one-stop hub for local services including housing, jobs, repair, courier, food, blood donation, clubs, online shops, car rental, and more across 18+ categories.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://smartfeni.com/): Search and browse all local service categories in Feni district.
- [About](https://smartfeni.com/about): Information about the Smart Feni platform and its mission.
- [Privacy Policy](https://smartfeni.com/privacy-policy): How user data is collected, used, and protected.

## Service Categories

- [Housing / বাসা ভাড়া](https://smartfeni.com/services/housing): Rental housing listings in Feni.
- [Jobs / চাকরির খবর](https://smartfeni.com/services/job): Local job postings.
- [Repair Services / রিপেয়ার সার্ভিস](https://smartfeni.com/services/repair): Home and appliance repair services.
- [Car Rental / গাড়ি ভাড়া](https://smartfeni.com/services/car-rental): Vehicle rental listings.
- [Courier / কুরিয়ার](https://smartfeni.com/services/courier): Delivery and courier services.
- [Blood Donors / ব্লাড ডোনার](https://smartfeni.com/services/blood): Blood donor directory by group and upazila.
- [Online Shop / অনলাইন শপ](https://smartfeni.com/services/online-shop): Local online shops and products.
- [Recycle Market / রিসাইকেল মার্কেট](https://smartfeni.com/services/recycle): Buy and sell recyclable/used goods.
- [Tuition / টিউশন](https://smartfeni.com/services/tuition): Tutors and tuition listings.
- [Sports & Events / খেলাধুলা ও ইভেন্টস](https://smartfeni.com/services/sports): Local sports and event listings.
- [Health / স্বাস্থ্য পরামর্শ](https://smartfeni.com/services/health): Health and medical guidance.

## Directories

- [Clubs](https://smartfeni.com/clubs): Local clubs and organizations in Feni district, with member rosters and events.
- [Shops](https://smartfeni.com/shop): Directory of registered local shops.
